purpose: Five fresh fictional same-subject cases with revised non-IP construction instructions; preserve all eleven original samples.

candidates.name: Pocket Forecast
candidates.direction: Pocket Forecast gives a calm immediate weather glance: one broad asymmetric cloud with a stable flat base partially covers a single sun, leaving a clear substantial sun crescent nestled into its upper-left contour; no detached rays or extra shapes. Treat the combined sun/cloud as one optically balanced flat mark.
candidates.comparison_criteria: Weather still reads; the sun/cloud relationship and characteristic cloud shoulder are clear; reduced ray fragments do not weaken recognition; no new clutter.

candidates.name: Quiet Focus
candidates.direction: Quiet Focus gathers attention into one calm rhythm: two broad interlocking rounded arcs share a coherent curvature and substantial weight around an open quiet center; opposing ends leave two deliberate openings, with no almost-touching tips, over/under shading, target dot, arrows or face. Preserve the current bold overall presence.
candidates.comparison_criteria: One coherent gesture and intended openings; arcs remain distinct; assess whether gathering/focus reads more clearly than a generic cycle without claiming literal semantic recognition.

candidates.name: 모아 Notes
candidates.direction: 모아 Notes feels compact and welcoming: draw only `모` (U+BAA8) with greater optical presence, an open upper ㅁ counter, controlled central stem and balanced broad ㅗ base; use one rounded terminal/corner family while retaining normal Hangul structure and comfortable breathing room. Add no other symbol or lettering.
candidates.comparison_criteria: Exact `모`, open counter and distinguishable structure; greater presence without cramped/cropped strokes; optical upper/lower balance. Component descriptions never replace the stored syllable with jamo.

candidates.direction: Pocket Sprout conveys gentle care through one plump heart-shaped jade leaf, softly asymmetric lobes and one shallow central fold; a smooth matte molded surface and broad upper-left light reveal restrained volume from a near-frontal view. candidates.name: Little Timer
candidates.direction: Little Timer makes time tangible: one chunky hourglass uses a single coarse square module, equally substantial turquoise top/bottom caps, matching side thickness and repeated staircase rhythm; one connected peach sand mass occupies only the upper chamber, while the lower chamber remains empty. No falling grains, secondary sand reservoir, smoothing, texture, glow, dithering, numerals or scenery.
candidates.comparison_criteria: Hourglass recognition; one upper sand region and empty lower region; coherent frame/steps and broad connected clusters; observe any remaining blur/grid inconsistency without claiming integer-perfect pixels.
